# Developing in WSL

The **{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} WSL** extension lets you use the [Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl) as your full-time development environment right from {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. You can develop in a Linux-based environment, use Linux-specific toolchains and utilities, and run and debug your Linux-based applications all from the comfort of Windows.

The extension runs commands and other extensions directly in WSL so you can edit files located in WSL or the mounted Windows filesystem (for example `/mnt/c`) without worrying about pathing issues, binary compatibility, or other cross-OS challenges.  The extension will install {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Server inside WSL; the server is independent of any existing {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} installation in WSL.

![WSL Architecture](images/wsl/architecture-wsl.png)

This lets {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} provide a **local-quality development experience** — including full IntelliSense (completions), code navigation, and debugging — **regardless of where your code is hosted**.
